solutionSql:
CREATE TABLE dim_customer (
    customer_key integer GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    customer_name text NOT NULL UNIQUE
);

CREATE TABLE dim_route (
    route_key integer GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    origin text NOT NULL,
    destination text NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE (origin, destination)
);

CREATE TABLE fact_shipment (
    tracking_code text PRIMARY KEY,
    customer_key integer NOT NULL REFERENCES dim_customer (customer_key),
    route_key integer NOT NULL REFERENCES dim_route (route_key),
    weight_kg integer,
    status text NOT NULL,
    booked_at timestamptz NOT NULL
);

INSERT INTO dim_customer (customer_name)
SELECT DISTINCT customer_name
FROM staging_shipments_flat
WHERE customer_name IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY customer_name;

INSERT INTO dim_route (origin, destination)
SELECT DISTINCT origin, destination
FROM staging_shipments_flat
WHERE origin IS NOT NULL AND destination IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY origin, destination;

INSERT INTO fact_shipment (tracking_code, customer_key, route_key, weight_kg, status, booked_at)
SELECT f.tracking_code, c.customer_key, r.route_key, f.weight_kg, f.status, f.booked_at
FROM staging_shipments_flat AS f
JOIN dim_customer AS c ON c.customer_name = f.customer_name
JOIN dim_route AS r ON r.origin = f.origin AND r.destination = f.destination
ORDER BY f.tracking_code;
sampleChecks: dim_customer 6 rows, dim_route 4 rows (Alder Hub to Birch Yard, Birch Yard to Cedar Dock, Cedar Dock to Dahlia Terminal, Dahlia Terminal to Alder Hub), fact_shipment 60 rows, one per tracking_code with customer_key and route_key resolved. Counts are 6/4/60 on nulls and boundary too.
ambiguities: dim_route column names and its surrogate key name are not given. I used origin, destination and route_key (route_key is named by the fact spec). A state check on natural keys depends on these names.
Nullability of fact_shipment customer_key, route_key, status and booked_at is not stated. I made all four NOT NULL. Only weight_kg is stated as optional.
A NULL origin, destination or customer name in the flat extract is not addressed. No dataset has one, so the NULL behaviour is not exercised.
notes: Each dimension is loaded before the fact. The fact load is an inner join on the three flat columns and yields 60 rows on all datasets. Re-checked on the revised ticket text: dim_route columns and key are now named and customer_key and route_key are stated present, which closes original ambiguities 1 and 3. Status and booked_at presence is still not stated, and NULL names, origins or destinations are still unaddressed. Solution and results unchanged.
